faq.question: How can I trust providers? Is information transparent?
faq.answer: Each listing shows the provider's profile, reviews, and completed bookings when available. Read descriptions, ask questions via messaging before booking, and see our Trust & Safety page for platform commitments.

faq.question: What safety steps should I take before and after a booking?
faq.answer: Communicate through Uneden messaging, confirm scope and price before accepting. For in-person work, meet in public when possible and tell someone you trust. After the job, leave an honest review to help the community.

faq.question: What should I do if I have issues during an order?
faq.answer: Contact the other party via messaging first. If the dispute continues, open a request from your booking within the stated timeframe. Our team reviews evidence (messages, photos, job details) per our terms.

faq.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the provider or client?
faq.answer: Report the issue via the booking or report form. Depending on circumstances, partial refunds or mediation may apply. Repeated poor reviews or reports can lead to account action.

faq.question: What do reviews and ratings mean?
faq.answer: Reviews reflect real experiences after completed bookings. They help clients choose and providers build reputation. Uneden does not sell artificial "levels". Trust comes from history, reviews, and following the rules.

faq.question: How do payments work on Uneden?
faq.answer: Payments go through our secure system (Stripe). Clients see fee details before confirming; providers receive payouts per the payment terms schedule once the job is marked complete.

faq.question: What's the difference between "Offer" and "Looking" listings?
faq.answer: "Offer": a provider offers a service (e.g. cleaning, repairs). "Looking": someone needs help for a task with a budget. Both use messaging and bookings.

faq.question: Can I cancel a booking?
faq.answer: Cancellation rules depend on booking stage and terms shown at confirmation. See the terms of use and payment terms, or contact support for exceptional cases.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.paragraph: Uneden is a Canadian platform proudly based in Quebec, built with the vision of connecting people through real skills and meaningful work. We believe that everyone has something valuable to offer, and our mission is to make it easier for individuals to find opportunities, support their local communities, and create their own path to earning.

whatDrivesUs.title: What drives us
whatDrivesUs.paragraph: By bringing together clients and service providers in one trusted space, Uneden helps unlock the power of local talent and everyday expertise. We are driven by the idea that work should be accessible, flexible, and fair, by empowering people across Canada to grow, collaborate, and build stronger communities together.

georges.bio: Georges Rychel Moung is the co-founder, President, and CEO of Uneden, driven by a deep passion for technology and its potential to transform everyday life. After earning his associate degree in software engineering, he continued his studies in computer science, developing both technical insight and a strong understanding of the evolving job market. It was during this journey that he noticed a growing gap: while digital freelancing was expanding globally, many essential, hands-on skills remained excluded from these opportunities. With Uneden, his mission is to empower communities by connecting people to real opportunities, starting in Canada.

alexandre.bio: Alexandre Soglo Booh Louha is the co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of Uneden, a passionate technologist with a strong academic background in computer science from the Universite de Montreal. From an early stage, he demonstrated both technical excellence and an entrepreneurial mindset, always driven by the ambition to build impactful solutions. As the technical force behind Uneden, Alexandre designed and developed the platform from the ground up, turning vision into reality. If Georges laid the foundation and direction of the project, Alexandre engineered the structure that brings it to life. Together, they form a complementary partnership, combining strategy and execution to build a scalable and innovative platform for the future of local work.

trustSafetyPage.title: Trust & Safety
trustSafetyPage.intro: At Uneden, our goal is to create a safe and reliable platform where users can connect, collaborate, and complete services with confidence.

commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
items: Provide a secure platform for transactions through an escrow payment system
Enable transparent interactions via profiles, reviews, and messaging
Offer a structured dispute resolution process
commitment.note: We are committed to continuously improving the safety and trust of our platform.

payments.title: 2. Secure Payments
payments.intro: All payments are processed through the platform and held securely until the service is completed or a resolution is reached.
items: Payments are made in advance and held in escrow
Funds are released once the service is completed or after dispute resolution
Providers currently pay a 5%* platform commission on payouts (standard rate: 20%)
payments.warning: We strongly advise users not to make payments outside the platform.

disputes.title: 3. Disputes & Resolution
disputes.itemOne: Users have up to 3 days after service completion to open a dispute
disputes.itemTwo: Both parties may provide evidence (messages, photos, etc.)
disputes.itemThree: Uneden will review the case and determine an outcome
disputes.note: Refunds may be issued up to 50% of the transaction amount, depending on the situation.

reviews.title: 4. Reviews & Reputation
items: Users can leave reviews and ratings after each transaction
Reviews help others make informed decisions
We encourage honest and respectful feedback

responsibility.title: 5. User Responsibility
responsibility.intro: To ensure a safe experience, users should:
responsibility.itemOne: Carefully review profiles, ratings, and past work before booking
responsibility.itemFour: Use caution when meeting someone in person

location.title: 6. Location & Privacy
items: Their precise location
Or a general area
location.note: We recommend using an approximate location if you prefer increased privacy.

prohibited.title: 7. Prohibited Behavior
prohibited.intro: The following behaviors are strictly prohibited:
items: Fraud, scams, or misleading listings
Harassment, abusive language, or threats
Circumventing the platform's payment system
Posting false reviews or impersonating others
prohibited.note: Violations may result in account suspension or removal.

reporting.title: 8. Reporting Issues
reporting.intro: If you encounter suspicious or unsafe behavior:
items: Report it directly through the platform
Provide as much detail as possible
Our team will review reports and take appropriate action

The conduct of users
Any damages or losses resulting from interactions
disclaimer.note: Users engage with each other at their own risk.

payments.buyerFeeNote: Applicable taxes and certain third-party processing costs may also apply depending on the transaction context.

disputes.title: 6. Disputes & Refunds
disputes.itemOne: Before work begins, some bookings may be cancelled directly. An in-progress booking may instead be redirected to dispute review rather than cancelled automatically.
disputes.itemTwo: For a completed booking, a dispute generally must be opened within 3 days of completion, unless Uneden determines otherwise.
disputes.itemThree: After review, a refund, credit, partial reversal, or no adjustment at all may be granted depending on the information available.
refundPolicyItems: Outcomes are determined case by case based on messages, evidence, timelines, and platform records.

partial.paragraph: Some services may require deposits, materials, custom purchases, travel, or other pre-approved costs. These terms must be clearly agreed between users before work begins.

advertising.title: 9. Advertising
